nodes.title: Global convergence of the Fletcher–Reeves method under strong Wolfe steps

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a descent direction at a point with gradient $g$ ($g^\top d < 0$), and let the gradient $g' \ne 0$ at the next point satisfy the Wolfe curvature condition $g'^\top d \ge \sigma\, g^\top d$ with $\sigma < 1$. Then $d^\top (g' - g) \ge (\sigma - 1)\, g^\top d > 0$, and the Dai–Yuan direction $d' = -g' + \beta^{DY} d$ is again a descent direction: $g'^\top d' < 0$.
nodes.title: Descent of the Dai–Yuan direction

nodes.summary: Let $g, g', d$ be vectors of a real inner product space with $d^\top (g' - g) \ne 0$, and let $d' = -g' + \beta d$ with the Dai–Yuan parameter $\beta = \|g'\|^2 / d^\top (g' - g)$. Then Equivalently $\beta = g'^\top d' / g^\top d$. The identity propagates the sign of the directional derivative from one search direction to the next, and the source calls it "very important in our convergence analysis".
nodes.title: The Dai–Yuan identity
